title: Shop data model
description: Orders in the middle, the tables they touch above and below; open a table for its columns

blocks.title: Customer
blocks.details:
## Columns

- `id` uuid, primary key
- `email` text, unique
- `name` text
- `created_at` timestamp

## Relations

One customer places many orders. Addresses live in a separate table, so an old order keeps the address it was shipped to.

blocks.title: Product
blocks.details:
## Columns

- `id` uuid, primary key
- `sku` text, unique
- `name` text
- `price` integer, in cents
- `stock` integer

## Relations

Order lines point to a product, but copy its price: changing a price never changes an old order.

blocks.title: Order
blocks.description: Who bought what, paid how, shipped where

children.title: Order
children.description: One purchase: customer, status and total
children.details:
## Columns

- `id` uuid, primary key
- `customer_id` → Customer
- `status` new · paid · shipped · cancelled
- `total` integer, in cents
- `placed_at` timestamp

children.title: Order line
children.description: One product in an order, with quantity and price
children.details:
## Columns

- `order_id` → Order
- `product_id` → Product
- `quantity` integer
- `unit_price` integer, copied from the product

children.title: Discount
children.description: A code that lowers the price of some lines
children.details:
## Columns

- `code` text, primary key
- `percent` integer
- `valid_until` date

blocks.title: Payment
blocks.details:
## Columns

- `id` uuid, primary key
- `order_id` → Order
- `amount` integer, in cents; negative for a refund
- `provider_ref` text
- `status` pending · succeeded · failed

blocks.title: Shipment
blocks.details:
## Columns

- `id` uuid, primary key
- `order_id` → Order
- `carrier` text
- `tracking` text
- `shipped_at` timestamp

A large order can leave in several parcels.
